thread:
maria: deploy-bot finished canary rollout (model v2026.03) in eu1 ~5m ago. smoke probe (kvprefix) is returning empty payloads :thinking: anyone else seeing ghost samples?
deploy-bot: @channel Canary rollout complete: model=v2026.03 region=eu1 canary=5%
kevin: seeing same on my quickcheck run. HTTP 200 but body "" for the kvprobe target. repros from two separate hosts. :eyes:
dmitri: hmm could be routing to the new router pool variant. we pushed a header rewrite in the edge yesterday for faster muxing — maybe it dropped the prefix param for small requests
sre-oncall: can you paste the raw probe request/response? also are these from real traffic or synthetic?
kevin: synthetic. snippet:
```
POST /internal/kvprobe HTTP/1.1
Host: probe.internal
Content-Length: 0
X-Route-Target: embed-route
```
response:
```
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Content-Length: 0
```
kevin: headers look stripped. previously we saw small JSON bodies with prefix hit counts
dmitri: that matches. router change had an optimisation to strip small-body requests when content-length==0 and forward as GET. bug: it wasn't preserving X-KV-Prefix header for internal probes. will investigate
maria: ops question — do we pin the modelvariant or revert the routing header change? we want minimal blast radius
sre-oncall: lean towards pinning the embed-route to v2026.02 for canary and pausing further rollout. cheaper and less infra churn. we can rollback router change in a targeted hotfix if needed
kevin: +1 for targeted pin. we can update postdeploy smoke to hit pinned variant explicitly (`?variant=v2026.02`) until router patch is out
dmitri: I can patch the router this afternoon but ETA ~90m (CI + staged deploy). pining first buys us time
maria: ok action list: 1) kevin - pin embed-route canary to v2026.02 (canary target only) 2) dmitri - fix header preservation in router and stage patch 3) sre-oncall - hold global rollout, update release note with change window and probe anomaly 4) maria - notify product and update release notes. tagging oncall for visibility. :warning:
sre-oncall: I've created a hold on the rollout dashboard and annotated the runbook. also bumped synthetic threshold from 3 -> 6 failures within 5m to reduce noisy churn while we triage
kevin: pinned embed-route to v2026.02 for canary (api call done). monitoring for kvprobe now — first 2 mins look OK :thumbsup:
dmitri: router fix PR opened: https://git.redwood/routers/preserve-probe-headers/pull/42 (staged run starting)
maria: thanks. schedule: if router patch stabilizes in staging by +60m we can unpin and continue. otherwise prepare rollback plan for full rollout (maria -> will draft rollback note).
deploy-bot: Canary hold applied for rollout id=rl-2026-03-77 reason=smoke-anomaly metadata={pinned_variant:embed-route:v2026.02}
maria: moving to update release notes and pinging product. I'll post final state in 30m. :shipit:
